project_title: ERP Service Auto România — Enterprise Automotive Workshop Platform

theme_strategy.rationale: Automotive workshop command centers requirement high-contrast readability under bright fluorescent garage lights and intense night shift diagnostics. Deep obsidian dark mode paired with vibrant status accents (Amber, Signal Cyan, Emerald Green, Flame Red) gives maximum data density without eye strain.

hierarchy.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight uppercase font-heading
hierarchy.h2: text-xl sm:text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight uppercase font-heading
hierarchy.label_overline: text-[11px] font-bold tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-slate-400 font-sans

layout_and_spacing.sidebar_width: w-64 desktop, collapsable to w-16 or slide-over on mobile
layout_and_spacing.alignment_rules: Always left-align text data, tables, VIN numbers, and financial details. Right-align monetary amounts (RON / EUR) and metrics. Center badges and action buttons.

component_strategies.ui_library: Shadcn UI primitives with heavy industrial custom styling

navigation_header.visible_links_desktop: Always show current Module, Search VIN/Client input, Language Switcher (RO/EN), Theme Switcher (Dark/Light), Notification Bell, Quick Action (+ Notă Recepție), User Profile
navigation_header.sticky_header_classes: sticky top-0 z-40 backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/80 dark:bg-slate-950/80 border-b border-slate-800

data_tables.density: Compact, 40px row height for maximum scanability
data_tables.features: Column sorting, search filters, pagination, row highlight, click-to-expand details, action dropdowns
data_tables.borders: 1px solid border-slate-800, striped alternating rows in dark mode

work_order_kanban.card_style: Industrial card with VIN badge, mechanic avatar, progress bar, countdown timer, and total estimate

reception_wizard.signature_pad: Interactive Canvas Signature Pad for digital customer handover validation
reception_wizard.car_diagram: Interactive damage inspection map (click to mark scratches/dents)

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_requirement: CRITICAL: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, select dropdowns, tab triggers, modal buttons, language toggles, status pills, table action menus, print buttons) MUST have specific `data-testid` attributes in kebab-case format.
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_ratio: Minimum 4.5:1 for standard body text, 3:1 for large headers and status tags against background.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Use standard JS/JSX syntax throughout all components (.js files).
2. Implement full support for RO/EN language translation via a centralized state or i18n dictionary so every label, menu item, table header, and status has both Romanian and English strings.

3. Build all core enterprise modules: Dashboard Executiv (with KPI cards, Recharts graphics, elevator occupancy), CRM Clienți (Persoane fizice/juridice with CNP/CUI/Reg Com), Parc Auto (VIN lookup, car specs, history), Recepție Service (inspection wizard, photos upload slots, signature canvas pad), Comenzi de Lucru (Kanban + pipeline + line items for parts & labor), Devize (versioning & approval), Mecanici (time tracking, efficiency = billed hours/present hours), Magazie (NIR, OE/Aftermarket stocks, shelf location), Facturare (e-Factura ANAF XML generator/downloader), Încasări (cash/POS register log), and AI Advisor (Gemini OBD diagnostic assistant).
4. Implement responsive layout with collapsible dark sidebar, top navigation bar with search bar and user profile dropdown.
5. Ensure mock data is highly authentic with real Romanian car brands, VINs, Romanian CUI/CNP formats, and realistic RON pricing.
6. Include data-testid on every clickable or inspectable UI element.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Avoid standard centered Bootstrap-like templates. Use dense, high-utility tactical grids with sharp 1px borders, subtle glowing status accents, and crisp typography.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.dark_light_toggle: Default to dark theme while offering a top-nav toggle button for light mode.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Maintain generous internal padding inside containers to prevent border collisions.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_overlays: Never use fully transparent header or dropdown backgrounds. Always apply backdrop-blur with slate-900/95 or slate-950/95.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toasts: Use Sonner component at `/app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js` for action feedback (e.g., invoice generated, signature saved, work order updated).
